evidence.title: Color-Name.com: Find name of the color you love!

name: Color-Name.com
summary: Color lookup and conversion tool: find a color's name from a hex code and generate palettes, gradients and wallpapers.
description: Search millions of colors by name or hex code and get names, conversions (RGB, CMYK, Pantone, RAL) and downloadable palettes, patterns and wallpapers. Six tools cover a color visualizer, color name from image, contrast checker, code converter, palette generator and gradient creator.
contains: millions of colors searchable by name or hex code
tools: color visualizer, color name from image, contrast checker, code converter, palette generator, gradient creator
top, trending and newly added color lists
